name: Keto Chicken Parmesan Casserole
ingredients_verbatim: 3 chicken breasts cooked and cut into cubes (about 2 pounds)
why: Oven/broiler bake, low-carb chicken parm (6.5g carbs, 61g protein) with no breaded/fried cutlet - cubed cooked chicken breast under marinara, parmesan and mozzarella with a pork-rind crumb top. Maps to board (chicken-breast, pasta-sauce as marinara, parmesan, garlic-powder, italian-seasoning, olive-oil); shredded mozzarella has only generic shredded-cheese home and pork rinds have no board home (flagged - a good pricer-lane test). CONFIDENCE CAVEAT: at 609 cal it sits near the 650 ceiling, so our label-DB recompute could push it over the gate; selector should weigh that. In band on source numbers.
